answer: Each agent earns a reputation score recorded on a tamper‑proof ledger that grows daily like a sonnet’s verses, adding a small stake each sunrise. The score decays if the agent stays idle on its meadow of tasks, and any new identity must purchase a terrace of stake proportional to the cumulative reputation it wishes to inherit, forcing an attacker to spend exponential tokens for each fake node. Thus Sybil creation becomes financially prohibitive.
